column3: “Ask a riddle a riddle” is rendered “propound a riddle.”
“Full plumage, which had embroidery” is rendered “a full plumage of many colors.”
“Top shoots” is rendered “topmost of its young twigs.”
“Field of seed” is rendered “fertile soil”; the word for “willow” and “take” is uncertain.
“An eagle one” is rendered “another great eagle.”
“Offspring of royalty” is rendered “royal family,” and “leaders” as “mighty.”
“Messengers” is rendered “envoys,” and “a people numerous” as “many troops.”
“Place” is rendered “country,” and NASB supplies “put him on the throne.”
“Given his hand” is rendered “pledged his allegiance.”
“Fugitives” is rendered “choice men,” following many manuscripts.
“Mountain of the height” is rendered “high mountain,” and “cedar” as “stately cedar.”
